record.reason: The paper formalizes privacy-preserving collaboration among independently owned models and evaluates an SMPC/ensemble instantiation, discussing non-IID and overhead trade-offs. It is a serving paradigm, but evidence does not show a robust efficiency improvement over standalone inference; retain as a weak inference-systems lead.
record.title: Federated Inference: Toward Privacy-Preserving Collaborative and Incentivized Model Serving
